field.name: apportionment_formula
field.comment: AZ uses single-sales factor apportionment (AZ Rev. Stat. § 43-1139)

field.name: economic_nexus_threshold
field.comment: AZ economic nexus gross receipts threshold: $100,000 (AZ Rev. Stat. § 43-1102)

field.name: state_additions
field.comment: AZ additions: federal interest, IRC 199A addback, bonus depreciation (if decoupled)

field.name: state_credits
field.comment: AZ tax credits: R&D, renewable energy, employment, film production

field.name: state_subtractions
field.comment: AZ subtractions: AZ municipal interest, state taxes, AZ NOL

field.name: state_tax_rate
field.comment: AZ corporate income tax rate: 4.9% flat rate (AZ Rev. Stat. § 43-1111)

field.name: transaction_threshold
field.comment: AZ economic nexus transaction count threshold: 200 transactions
